name: @nessy-agent/codex-protocol
description: Generated TypeScript + JSON Schema bindings for the upstream codex app-server protocol (pinned to the openai/codex tag manifest.json names). Do not hand-edit generated/ or schema/. Consumed as DATA (manifest.json, schema/) and as parsed source text by two drift ties; nothing imports generated/*.ts as a module, and generated/ is in no typecheck program. The README states what checks it, what does not, and what wiring it in would cost.
